title: Round 10 / ECDLP-28: frontier exploration A (mathematics and physics analogies)
question: Propose and cheaply test deliberately unconventional but sensible ideas toward faster ECDLP drawn from mathematics/physics analogies not yet investigated by the lab.

claims: T3 (experimental, toy p<=12011): second p-adic digits u,v of the homomorphic section E(F_p)->E(Z/p^2) have Berlekamp-Massey linear complexity n/2 and no P-recursive relation (order<=3, degree<=3) in 12/12 sequences; positive controls detected.
T1 (experimental, p~2^20, M<=1500): x(jP) is not an approximate Freiman homomorphism: index-additive share of additive/multiplicative coincidences within |z|<=1.3 of permutation null; controls fire.

T2 (experimental, N~2e4): k-landscape autocorrelations <=0.022 (noise level 0.007); annealing success 39/400,24/400 <= random sampling 50/400,57/400 at 10 sqrt(N) evaluations. Consistent with random energy model.
Brainstorm: 15 ideas, 12 killed with reasons; elliptic-net zero lattice reformulation equals BSGS. Unproved speculation: Birkhoff-sum form of the section digit.
next_action: Optional 10-minute follow-up of F-A1: explicit cocycle eta and p^3 digit structure; otherwise all three developed ideas are refuted at toy sizes. PI to review report.
